description: This file defines the Tracker class for SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, including methods for retrieving recent items, making items invisible, and logging page views. It manages tracker data and user navigation history.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: Represents a tracker entity in SuiteCRM, handling user activity tracking, recent views, and visibility toggling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tracker object, loading vardefs if necessary.

methods.name: get_recently_viewed
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently viewed items for a user, optionally filtered by modules.

methods.name: makeInvisibleForAll
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a specific item to invisible for all users.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Overrides to support ACL roles, returns false.
